name: Nestle KitKat
ingredients: Sugar, Milk solids (16.2%), Fractionated vegetable fat, Hydrogenated vegetable fats. Refined Wheat flour (Maida), Cocoa solids (4.5%), Emulsifier (Soya lecithin), Yeast, Raising agent (500(i)). Artificial (Vanilla) flavouring substance, Iodised salt, Flour treatment agent (516) and Nature identical flavouring substance.
